contract.purpose: Preserve actual native routes, contact actions, editable assistant handoffs, consented updates and final studio discovery in the selected Precise composition.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Backend-free browser footer composition retaining host state and product identity.
contract.audience: Public Fleet visitors and applicable browser product users; SaaS Maker visitors reviewing public products and reusable tools.
contract.job: Close the actual SaaS Maker home and directory with compact native grouped navigation, real service controls, the product signature and original illustration, then a single final studio line.
contract.thesis: Implement selected Precise: compact Geist navigation, Geist Mono category labels, open AI and updates, product-native signature bleeding into original art, final full-width studio line.
contract.system: Selected C across the catalog-required browser surfaces; preserve product-specific tokens and actual service lifecycle.
contract.signature: Newsreader Atlas signature fades into the original detailed cabinet; CodeVetter uses its treatment sans signature over the original evidence chamber.
contract.risk: Asynchronous capture/feedback loads and intermediate footer widths can expose focus or wrapping regressions; inspect actual HTTP build and retain explicit unavailable/retry states.
contract.qualityBar: No nested narrow email column, no oversized CTA panel, no dropped native routes or consent state. Geist UI, Geist Mono labels, real16px inputs,44px targets, original SaaS Maker art and one final studio line; no document overflow at390/768/1440px.
